title: SFT corpus v3: self-contained, evidence-grounded examples with whole datasets held out
request: Make paired instruction data an SFT job can train on directly, cleaner than v1, and show how to run the training job.
spec: build_sft_dataset_v3.py writing RAFT-style examples (the evidence the answer depends on is in the prompt) in chat, Alpaca and ShareGPT formats, with whole datasets held out for validation; quality gates against paths, hashes and contradicted critic claims; train_lora.py (TRL with LoRA) and eval_sft.py (deterministic scoring, no LLM judge); docs/guides/SFT_DATA_GUIDE.md.
plan: Give every example a dataset card (what the data predicts), a stage card (what the stage does) and a setup summary (what was compared in that run).
Build seven tasks: grounded QA, explain an experiment, critique a claim, apply a selection rule, judge leakage, reason with a rule, and workflow steps.
Drop critic challenges the gate contradicts; reject examples with a path, hash or excessive length.
Hold out heart_disease, spambase and the clothing reviews entirely; split dataset-free examples by hash.
Write the LoRA trainer and the deterministic evaluator; check the evaluator scores the reference answers 1.0.

decisions.decision: Hold out whole datasets for validation.
decisions.why: Examples from the same dataset are near-duplicates; a random split would measure memory, not reasoning.

decisions.decision: Put the evidence in the prompt (RAFT-style).
decisions.why: The model should learn to reason from given evidence, which retrieval will supply in use, rather than recite facts.

decisions.decision: Score with a deterministic evaluator, not an LLM judge.
decisions.why: A judge model adds its own errors to the measurement.

change: research/llm-fine-tuning/experiments/sft/build_sft_dataset_v3.py, out_v3/ (examples and MANIFEST.json), train_lora.py, eval_sft.py and the SFT guide; make sft-v3 and a freshness check.

findings.defect: Examples asked about an experiment id without saying what the experiment was.
findings.scenario: A v1 example asked 'What did experiment EXP-023 on the credit_default dataset find during the feature engineering stage?' and answered 'Use the raw feature recipe ... 0.7317 mean training-CV ROC-AUC' without saying what credit_default predicts, what the stage does or what was compared. Training on it teaches a model to recite 'EXP-023 said X'.
findings.cause: The v1 builder turned claim-memory lines into questions and kept only their ids as context.
findings.fix: Every v3 example carries the dataset card, the stage card and the run's setup summary, all taken from the records, never invented.

measurements.name: corpus v3 build
measurements.gate: Whole datasets held out; contradicted challenges dropped; no example with a path, hash or excess length.
measurements.result: 326 examples at the commit; 330 after later rebuilds (264 train, 66 validation): grounded QA 83, critique 80, explain 70, apply a rule 42, leakage 23, rules 22, workflow 10; 10 contradicted challenges dropped, 147 kept, 0 rejected by the path and hash gate.
measurements.next: SLM-001: score the base model on the held-out datasets; SLM-002: fine-tune with LoRA and compare; SLM-003: compare with a large hosted model given the same records.

outcome: A training-ready corpus with a trainer and a scorer. No training ran, because there was no GPU; the trainer was only checked to compile.
lessons: Train on the reasoning, with its evidence in view, not on the id of the experiment that produced it.
Hold out by the unit that creates near-duplicates (the dataset, later the whole project).
